description: This file defines an abstract class 'MessagingOptions' which contains configuration settings for messaging behavior in Orleans, including timeout settings, message size limits, and message retry policies.

classes.name: MessagingOptions
classes.description: Abstract class providing configurational options for messaging, including timeout durations, message size limits, and retry policies.

methods.name: ResponseTimeout
methods.description: Gets or sets the default response timeout, with special behavior if a debugger is attached.

methods.name: ResponseTimeoutWithDebugger
methods.description: Gets or sets a response timeout value used when a debugger is attached.

methods.name: DropExpiredMessages
methods.description: Indicates if messages should be dropped once they expire.

methods.name: ConfiguredResponseTimeout
methods.description: Returns the response timeout value without debugger checks.

methods.name: MaxMessageHeaderSize
methods.description: Maximum size in bytes for message headers.

methods.name: MaxMessageBodySize
methods.description: Maximum size in bytes for message bodies.

methods.name: CancelRequestOnTimeout
methods.description: Indicates if request cancellation should be attempted when a request times out.

methods.name: WaitForCancellationAcknowledgement
methods.description: Indicates whether local calls should be canceled immediately when cancellation is signaled.
